payout_quote: Open a new BMO Smart Money Checking account using the promo code and receive a $200 cash bonus when you have at least 5 qualifying electronic transactions
payout_value_note: flat $200 checking bonus; optional Savings Builder rewards add up to $60 (12 x $5 monthly)
biggest_catch: UC Berkeley students only — must present a Cal 1 Card, transcript, class schedule, or acceptance letter at account opening with promo code BSFP-11115H-STUSS26 and BAW code Z07.
catches: UC Berkeley students only; must present Cal 1 Card, transcript, class schedule, or acceptance letter at account opening.
Must provide promo code BSFP-11115H-STUSS26 and UC Berkeley Student BAW code Z07 at account opening.
Offer only valid for accounts opened May 5, 2026 through December 31, 2026.
Cannot be combined with any other offer; limited to one per client and account.
Not available to existing BMO personal checking clients or those who closed a BMO personal checking account within the past 12 months.
Bonus may be reported to the IRS; recipient responsible for applicable taxes.
Account must be open, in good standing, with a balance greater than zero when the bonus is paid (~100 days after opening).
Qualifying electronic transactions exclude internal BMO-to-BMO transfers, ATM transactions, and debit card returns.
Optional Savings Builder: $25 minimum to open; $5 monthly reward only in months the balance grows by at least $200, up to 12 months ($60 total).
eligibility: Current UC Berkeley students (or incoming students with an acceptance letter) who are not existing BMO personal checking clients and have not closed a BMO personal checking account in the past 12 months.
numeric_basis: payout from official BMO offer terms ($200 flat + optional $60); time: account opening plus 5 qualifying electronic transactions, est. 45-90 min active
timing: Open by December 31, 2026; 5 qualifying electronic transactions must post within 90 days of opening; $200 bonus deposited ~100 days after opening; savings rewards within 5 calendar days after each qualifying month-end.
steps: Open a new BMO Smart Money Checking account at the on-campus BMO financial center (MLK Building, 2495 Bancroft Way, Berkeley CA) or by calling 1-800-546-6101, providing promo code BSFP-11115H-STUSS26 and UC Berkeley Student BAW code Z07.
Present UC Berkeley enrollment proof: Cal 1 Card, transcript, class schedule, or acceptance letter.
Have 5 qualifying electronic transactions post within 90 days of opening (ACH, realtime payments, online bill pay, mobile deposits, wire transfers, or debit card purchases).
$200 cash bonus is deposited into the checking account ~100 days after opening; keep it open, in good standing, with a positive balance.
Optional: open a Savings Builder account and grow the balance by $200+ each month to earn $5 monthly rewards for up to 12 months ($60 total).
